sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最迫切的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The five basic principles of flag design.
sentences.zh: 旗帜设计的五大基本原则。

sentences.en: According to the North American Vexillological Association.
sentences.zh: 根据北美旗帜学协会的说法。

sentences.en: Vexillological.
sentences.zh: 旗帜学的。

sentences.en: Vexillology is the study of flags.
sentences.zh: 旗帜学是研究旗帜的学科。

sentences.en: That's the extra law.
sentences.zh: 那是额外的规则。

sentences.en: That makes it sound weird.
sentences.zh: 这听起来怪怪的。

sentences.en: Number one, keep it simple.
sentences.zh: 第一条，保持简单。

sentences.en: The flag should be so simple that a child can draw it from memory.
sentences.zh: 旗帜应该简单到小孩子凭记忆就能画出来。

sentences.en: Before I moved to Chicago in 2005, I didn't even know cities had their own flags.
sentences.zh: 在我2005年搬到芝加哥之前，我甚至不知道城市还有自己的旗帜。

sentences.en: Most larger cities have flags.
sentences.zh: 大多数大城市都有旗帜。

sentences.en: Well, I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我以前不知道。

sentences.en: That's Ted K, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，那是泰德·K。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Flag expert.
sentences.zh: 旗帜专家。

sentences.en: Totally awesome guy.
sentences.zh: 超级棒的家伙。

sentences.en: I'm the editor of a scholarly journal on flags called Raven, a journal of vexillology.
sentences.zh: 我是《渡鸦》这本关于旗帜的学术期刊的主编，这是一本旗帜学杂志。

sentences.en: And that first city flag I discovered in Chicago is a beaut.
sentences.zh: 我在芝加哥发现的第一面城市旗帜真是一件艺术品。

sentences.en: A white field, two light blue horizontal stripes, and four six-pointed red stars across the middle.
sentences.zh: 白色的底色，两条浅蓝色的横条，中间有四颗六角红星。

sentences.en: Number two.
sentences.zh: 第二条。

sentences.en: The blue stripes represent the water, the lake, and the rivers.
sentences.zh: 蓝色的条纹代表水、湖泊和河流。

sentences.en: Use meaningful symbolism.
sentences.zh: 使用有意义的象征。

sentences.en: The red stars represent significant events in Chicago's history.
sentences.zh: 红星代表芝加哥历史上重大事件。

sentences.en: The design of the Chicago flag has complete buy-in with an entire cross-section of the city.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥旗帜的设计得到了该市各阶层民众的完全认可。

sentences.en: It's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 它无处不在。

sentences.en: Every municipal building flies the flag.
sentences.zh: 每个市政府大楼都飘扬着这面旗帜。

sentences.en: Every 20-year-old's messenger bag and hoodie has one.
sentences.zh: 每个20岁年轻人的邮差包和连帽衫上都有它。

sentences.en: It's a distinct symbol of Chicago's pride.
sentences.zh: 它是芝加哥骄傲的鲜明象征。

sentences.en: When a police officer or firefighter dies in Chicago, it's not a United States flag on a casket.
sentences.zh: 在芝加哥，当警察或消防员殉职时，盖在棺材上的不是美国国旗。

sentences.en: It's the city of Chicago flag.
sentences.zh: 而是芝加哥市的市旗。

sentences.en: That's how deeply it's gotten into the city's civic imagery.
sentences.zh: 这就是它多么深入这座城市的公民形象中。

sentences.en: And it isn't just that people love Chicago and therefore love the flag.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为人们热爱芝加哥，所以才热爱这面旗帜。

sentences.en: I also think that people love Chicago more because the flag is so cool.
sentences.zh: 我还认为，正因为这面旗帜太酷了，人们才更热爱芝加哥。

sentences.en: A positive feedback loop there between great symbolism and civic pride.
sentences.zh: 伟大的象征意义与公民自豪感之间存在着一个正反馈循环。

sentences.en: So when I moved back to San Francisco in 2008, I researched its flag because I'd never seen it before in the previous eight years I lived here.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我2008年搬回旧金山时，我研究了它的旗帜，因为在我在这里居住的前八年里，我从来没见过它。

sentences.en: And I found it, I'm sorry to say, sadly lacking.
sentences.zh: 我发现它，遗憾地说，实在是差强人意。

sentences.en: Well, let me start at the top.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我从头说起。

sentences.en: Number one.
sentences.zh: 第一条。

sentences.en: Keeping it simple.
sentences.zh: 保持简单。

sentences.en: So simple that a child can draw it from memory.
sentences.zh: 简单到小孩子凭记忆就能画出来。

sentences.en: It's a relatively complex flag.
sentences.zh: 这是一面相对复杂的旗帜。

sentences.en: The main component of the San Francisco flag is a phoenix, representing our rising from the ashes after the great fires of the 1850s.
sentences.zh: 旧金山旗帜的主要元素是一只凤凰，代表我们在1850年代的大火后从灰烬中崛起。

sentences.en: A powerful symbol for San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 对于旧金山来说这是一个强有力的象征。

sentences.en: I still don't really dig the phoenix.
sentences.zh: 我其实还是不太喜欢这只凤凰。

sentences.en: Design-wise, it has too many details and too many colors and it doesn't really work at a distance.
sentences.zh: 从设计上看，它的细节太多，颜色也太多，在远处看效果并不好。

sentences.en: But having deep meaning puts that element in the plus column.
sentences.zh: 但具有深远的意义为这个元素加分不少。

sentences.en: Behind the large phoenix, the background is mainly white.
sentences.zh: 在大凤凰的后面，背景主要是白色的。

sentences.en: But the flag also has a substantial gold border around it.
sentences.zh: 但旗帜周围还有一条醒目的金色边框。

sentences.en: Which is a very attractive design element.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常吸引人的设计元素。

sentences.en: It does look pretty good.
sentences.zh: 它看起来确实挺不错的。

sentences.en: But here come the big no-nos in flag design.
sentences.zh: 但接下来是旗帜设计中的大忌。

sentences.en: No lettering or seals.
sentences.zh: 不要有文字或徽章。

sentences.en: Never use writing of any kind.
sentences.zh: 绝不使用任何形式的文字。

sentences.en: Underneath the phoenix, there's a motto on a ribbon that translates to,
sentences.zh: 在凤凰下方，丝带上有一句座右铭，翻译过来是，

sentences.en: Gold in peace, iron in war.
sentences.zh: 和平中见黄金，战争中见钢铁。

sentences.en: Plus, and this is the big problem, it says San Francisco across the bottom.
sentences.zh: 另外，这也是最大的问题，底部写着“旧金山”。

sentences.en: If you need to write the name of what you're representing on your flag, your symbolism has failed.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要在旗帜上写出你所代表的名称，你的象征意义就失败了。

sentences.en: The United States flag doesn't say USA across the front.
sentences.zh: 美国国旗正面并没有写着“美国”字样。

sentences.en: But the good news is, this name thing might not be completely our fault.
sentences.zh: 但好消息是，这个写名字的问题可能不完全是我们的错。

sentences.en: A city flag in a state that has its own name on the state flag would tend to echo that.
sentences.zh: 一个州的州旗上写着自己名字的城市，其市旗往往也会呼应这一点。

sentences.en: Yep, the California bear flag says California Republic on it.
sentences.zh: 没错，加州的熊旗上写着“加利福尼亚共和国”。

sentences.en: So maybe we can blame this all on our capital city, Sacramento.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我们可以把这一切归咎于我们的首府萨克拉门托。

sentences.en: Which is awesome because I love blaming Sacramento for things.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了，因为我喜欢把事情怪罪到萨克拉门托头上。

sentences.en: I like to say that in every bad flag, there's a good flag trying to get out.
sentences.zh: 我常说，每一面糟糕的旗帜背后，都藏着一面想要挣脱出来的优秀旗帜。

sentences.en: Well, the way to make San Francisco's flag a good flag would be to take the motto off,
sentences.zh: 好吧，让旧金山的旗帜变得优秀的方法就是去掉座右铭，

sentences.en: because you can't read that at a distance.
sentences.zh: 因为你在远处根本看不清它。

sentences.en: I would take the name off, and the border might even be made thicker,
sentences.zh: 我会去掉名字，甚至可以把边框加粗，

sentences.en: so it's more of a part of the flag.
sentences.zh: 让它更像是旗帜整体的一部分。

sentences.en: And I would just simply take the phoenix and make it a great big element in the middle of the flag.
sentences.zh: 我会直接把凤凰变成旗帜中央一个巨大的元素。

sentences.en: But the current phoenix has got to go.
sentences.zh: 但现有的这只凤凰必须得换掉。

sentences.en: I would simplify or stylize the phoenix.
sentences.zh: 我会简化或风格化这只凤凰。

sentences.en: Depict a big wide-winged bird coming out of flame.
sentences.zh: 描绘一只从烈火中腾飞的宽翼大鸟。

sentences.en: Emphasize the flame.
sentences.zh: 着重强调火焰。

sentences.en: So next time you find yourself with a vexillologist,
sentences.zh: 所以，下次你遇到一位旗帜学家时，

sentences.en: I am never going to say that word right.
sentences.zh: 我永远也念不对这个词。

sentences.en: A flag expert?
sentences.zh: 一位旗帜专家？

sentences.en: Park yourself there.
sentences.zh: 坐在那儿别走。

sentences.en: You're in for a good time.
sentences.zh: 你会有段美妙的时光。

sentences.en: By the North American Vexillological Association.
sentences.zh: 由北美旗帜学协会提供。

sentences.en: See, it's not just me.
sentences.zh: 看，不只是我。

sentences.en: It's not just me.
sentences.zh: 不只是我。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了 Lunar 的支持。

sentences.en: It's a product of KALW, the American Institute of Architects San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 它是 KALW、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会

sentences.en: and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 以及建筑与设计中心的出品。

sentences.en: To look at pictures of flags and a guide to how to design a good one,
sentences.zh: 要查看旗帜图片以及如何设计一面好旗帜的指南，

sentences.en: go to 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
